notes: «ح» joins two branches that meet at الوليد; the names after the last «ح» are written once and form the shared tail
«وحديث عبد الرحمن أتم» and «قال عبد الرحمن عن مروان بن جناح» are wording and restatement remarks, left out
Wathila is the Companion who reports the Prophet's prayer, so he is the last link
